case_name: Sri Pal Singh vs The General Manager Icici Lombard ...
author: Uday Umesh Lalit

paragraphs.text:
REVIEW PETITION (C) DIARY NO. 22591 OF 2021
 SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (C) NO. 6380 OF 2019

THE GENERAL MANAGER, ICICI LOMBARD GENERAL
 INSURANCE CO. PVT. LIMITED & ANR. …Respondents

O R D E R
There is delay of 888 days in preferring the instant review petition.
We have gone through the application seeking condonation of delay.
The explanation offered is not satisfactory at all.
We, therefore, refuse to condone delay. Consequently, the review

petition is dismissed on the ground of delay.
……………………………….J.
 [Uday Umesh Lalit]
